title: Privilege escalation, sandbox escape due to use-after-free in the Graphics: CanvasWebGL component. (CVE-2026-124907)
description: CVE-2026-124907 is a high-severity vulnerability in Mozilla Firefox's Graphics: CanvasWebGL component involving a use-after-free flaw. This vulnerability could allow an attacker to escalate privileges and escape the browser sandbox. The issue was addressed and fixed in Firefox version 160 and Firefox ESR 153.7.
